title: The 4 Best Fitness Trackers for Swimming
h1: The 4 Best Fitness Trackers for Swimming
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for fitness trackers for swimming, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at fitness trackers for swimming using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Fitbit Charge 6 Fitness Tracker
products.blurb: Key specs: 50-meter water resistance, Dedicated pool swim exercise mode, Built-in GPS for open water sessions.
strengths: Pool swim mode logs lap count and pace reliably in a standard 25-meter or 25-yard pool
Built-in GPS gives a usable distance estimate for open water swims
50-meter rating handles both recreational and lap swimming without concern
Heart rate readings continue underwater, unlike some optical sensors that pause
limitations: Stroke type recognition occasionally misclassifies technique drills
Touchscreen is unresponsive underwater, so controls need to happen poolside
GPS accuracy drops noticeably in open water compared to land-based runs
features: Built-in GPS for open water sessions

products.name: Garmin Vivosmart 5
products.blurb: Key specs: 5 ATM water resistance, Pool swim activity profile, Body Battery recovery tracking.
strengths: Body Battery helps swimmers gauge whether to push a hard interval set or ease off
No subscription needed to see full swim history and trends
Silicone band held up well to repeated chlorine exposure over several months
limitations: No built-in GPS, so open water swims rely on a nearby phone or estimate only
Touchscreen requires a firm, deliberate tap when wet
Smaller display makes checking mid-set lap count harder to read at a glance

products.name: Amazfit Band 7
products.blurb: Key specs: 5 ATM water resistance, Pool swim sport mode, 18-day battery life.
strengths: 18-day battery life means it can go a full month of regular pool sessions between charges
AMOLED display remains legible through goggles at the pool wall
Simple interface makes starting and stopping a swim session quick poolside
limitations: Lap counting is less consistent than Fitbit or Garmin in mixed-stroke sessions
No built-in GPS limits open water use to rough estimates
Band clasp needs a firmer check before diving in, per owner reports of loosening

products.name: Garmin Forerunner 165 Running Smartwatch
strengths: Built-in GPS for pace and distance
Long battery for a GPS watch

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
